title: Creosote Labs
meta_description: Creosote Labs is a research organization working on applied AI: what these systems do once they are deployed into a working business. We also develop products.

hero.h1: Creosote Labs is a research organization working on applied AI: what these systems do once they are deployed into a working business.
hero.sub: We build and run systems in production, publish notes on what we find, and develop products of our own.

areas.name: Operations systems
areas.text: Software that runs scheduling, inventory and logistics for businesses whose work is booked in advance and carried out in the field. A change entered once, such as a guest's dietary restriction, reaches every list that depends on it.

areas.name: Document tooling
areas.text: Tools that pull structure out of documents laid out for people rather than machines: contracts, agency forms and flat PDF packets. The output includes the page and position of each field, down to every signature and initial line in a contract packet.

areas.name: Teaching applications
areas.text: Applications that turn a fixed body of source material into something a specific reader can work through. The work includes placing the reader at the right level and checking what they learned, with placement exams, graded answers and spaced review.

areas.name: Assessment and course engines for practitioners
areas.text: Software that runs an assessment on a practitioner's website, sends the email that follows it and sells the practitioner's courses. The assessment brings in new contacts, and course payments run through Stripe.
